description: This PHP source file defines the VendorHardeningPlugin class, a Composer plugin for cleaning vendor directories in Drupal projects to enhance security by removing directory paths within installed packages.

classes.name: VendorHardeningPlugin
classes.description: A Composer plugin class that implements security measures to harden the vendor directory by removing sensitive paths and configuring access restrictions.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with Composer and IO objects, and sets up configuration.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of Composer script events and corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: onPostAutoloadDump
methods.description: Handles the autoload dump event to place access restriction files in the vendor directory.

methods.name: onPostCmd
methods.description: Handles post-update and post-install commands to clean all packages.

methods.name: onPrePackageInstall
methods.description: Handles pre-package install event to remove binaries before cleanup.

methods.name: onPrePackageUpdate
methods.description: Handles pre-package update event to remove binaries before cleanup.

methods.name: onPostPackageInstall
methods.description: Handles post-package install event to clean the package.

methods.name: onPostPackageUpdate
methods.description: Handles post-package update event to clean the package.

methods.name: removeBinBeforeCleanup
methods.description: Removes binary configurations that overlap with cleanup paths.

methods.name: findBinOverlap
methods.description: Finds binaries that are located within cleanup directories.

methods.name: getInstalledPackages
methods.description: Retrieves all installed packages from Composer.

methods.name: getInstallPathForPackage
methods.description: Gets the installation path for a specific package.

methods.name: cleanAllPackages
methods.description: Cleans all configured packages after an update or install.

methods.name: cleanPackage
methods.description: Cleans a specific package based on configuration.

methods.name: cleanPathsForPackage
methods.description: Removes specified directories within a package's install path.

methods.name: writeAccessRestrictionFiles
methods.description: Creates .htaccess files in the vendor directory to restrict access.
